name: moo-family-bookshelf
description: Chrome Extension for Readmoo family account members to browse each other's shared books
author: Reginna Chao

scripts.dev: concurrently -n ext,worker,pwa,info -c blue,green,magenta,yellow "pnpm --filter moo-family-bookshelf-extension dev" "pnpm --filter moo-family-bookshelf-worker dev" "pnpm --filter moo-family-bookshelf-pwa dev" "node scripts/dev-info.mjs"
scripts.dev:remote: concurrently -n ext,pwa,info -c blue,magenta,yellow "pnpm --filter moo-family-bookshelf-extension dev:remote" "pnpm --filter moo-family-bookshelf-pwa dev:remote" "node scripts/dev-info.mjs --remote"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter moo-family-bookshelf-extension build && pnpm --filter moo-family-bookshelf-worker build
scripts.build:dev: pnpm --filter moo-family-bookshelf-extension build:dev && pnpm --filter moo-family-bookshelf-pwa build:dev && pnpm --filter moo-family-bookshelf-worker build:dev
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm --filter moo-family-bookshelf-extension test:coverage && pnpm --filter moo-family-bookshelf-pwa test:coverage && pnpm --filter moo-family-bookshelf-worker test:coverage
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run test:e2e:extension && pnpm run test:e2e:pwa
scripts.test:e2e:extension: pnpm --filter moo-family-bookshelf-extension build:e2e && pnpm --filter moo-family-bookshelf-extension test:e2e
